## Checklist before review

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean
- [ ] `npm test` passes (unit)
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` passes (API routes)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (Playwright smoke tests), if UI changed
- [ ] Branch named per conventions (`feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`, `refactor/*`)
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` values committed
